title: Ransomware group pages and clearnet onion search (P203)
notes: Batch p2-G14-2, module pivots_darkweb. Links under x_module_links need a value transformation, a TLP ceiling or a warning that the frozen core link model does not carry yet: the pack's module renders them (linted like pack links, fail closed). Rule 3: claim pages, leak-file, download and victim-file URLs are never linked or generated. Order (P203 cond 6): ransomware group pages first, then onion search.

links.label: ransomware.live - search (groups and victim posts)
links.notes: GET search form (field q), verified 2026-11-26 (200, 'lockbit'). Search results only, never claim pages (rule 3). Threat-actor values use the group page when the per-site slug is known, this search otherwise (module link rlive_search_actor, P203 cond 8).

x_module_links.label: RansomLook - ransomware group page
x_module_links.notes: Slug from x_tracker_slugs resolved through the P295 alias index (P203 cond 8). An unknown slug answers 302 to the home page and RansomLook has no GET search URL (POST form): without a known slug no RansomLook link is rendered.

x_module_links.label: ransomware.live - ransomware group page
x_module_links.notes: Slug from x_tracker_slugs resolved through the P295 alias index (P203 cond 8); an unknown slug answers 404.

x_module_links.label: ransomware.live - search for the group name (no known group page)
x_module_links.notes: Rendered only when no ransomware.live slug is known: the site's search URL instead of a guessed path (P203 cond 8).

x_module_links.label: OnionSearchEngine - clearnet onion search (IOC values only)
x_module_links.notes: Unknown-tier operator: IOC values only (domain, onion), 'unknown operator' badge, hidden from reports at TLP:AMBER and above (max_tlp green, P203 cond 10). Research C0472 verified the form with '&submit=Search' on 2026-11-25; that token is dropped (the P327 submission lint rejects it) and the page answered a Cloudflare block (403) to curl on 2026-11-26: unverified until a browser re-check. Nothing is ever auto-fetched (P203 cond 11).
x_module_links.x_warning: illicit content, possibly child sexual abuse material (possession is a crime, ECA art. 241-B): open only in the team's isolated browsing environment

x_tracker_slugs.doc: Per-site group names (P203 cond 8), keyed by the names the P295 alias index resolves to (normalised with actor_alias_index.normalise_alias). Each slug was checked by the maintainer (HEAD 200 on the group page; an unknown group is 302 on RansomLook and 404 on ransomware.live). A group not listed here gets no RansomLook link and the ransomware.live search link, never a guessed path. Re-check every 180 days (P203 cond 7).
